[size=4][b]Misc Map Actions & Properties[/b][/size]
Adds a few map related features, no strong design theme just whatever I happen to want.

[size=4][b]This is a framework mod for other mods to use, installing it by itself does nothing for players.[/b][/size]

Features include[list]
[*]Make fruit trees in greenhouse type locations visually obey seasons
[*]Add light rays to a map like island forest
[*]Change ambient lighting to something like the secret woods
[*]Add panorama background, kind of like the summit but very customizable
[*]Add a repeating texture overlay, kind of like bathhouse steam
[*]Forces animals to go to specific spots in the house
[*]Add lights to the map and buildings via tile data
[*]Conditionally add lights to a mill type building while it is processing things
[*]Add temporary animated sprites to the map
[*]Action to display construction menu
[*]Action to display shipping bin menu
[*]Action to warp by a hole, like skull caves
[*]Action to show a question dialogue and activate further actions in response to player choice
[*]Change when sunset and night time happen in a location
[*]Extend building draw layers so that you can rotate sprites
[*]Change where the crib is in farmhouse
[*]Change where the fridge is in farmhouse, and optionally the door open sprite
[*]Trigger when farmhouse is upgraded
[*]Action to shift contents in a farmhouse when upgraded, so that people's stuff don't end up in the void in a custom farmhouse, plus a map property to block the vanilla shift contents action.
[*]Simple critter spawning (fireflies, crabs, seagull, birdies, butterflies, rabbits)
[*]Give furniture access to tile properties/actions, descriptions, collision maps, and draw layers.
[*]Give paths access to tile properties/actions.
[*]Show a global inventory from a tile action.
[*]Use a MagicWarp/HoleWarp to enter a building, and/or change where the player lands upon entry.
[*]Use a MagicWarp/HoleWarp to leave a building, essentially creating multiple ways out.
[*]Make a particular spot valid for paddy crops, regardless of whether there is water nearby.
[*]Use a single action to do ChangeIntoSwimsuit/ChangeOutOfSwimsuit/PoolEntrance, for easier bathtub/swiming pool setups.
[*]Set up object/furniture to have connected textures, kind of like paths.
[/list]
Please see [url=https://github.com/Mushymato/MiscMapActionsProperties/blob/main/README.md]README.md[/url] for documentation.

[size=4][b]Updates

[/b][/size]Because this is a framework mod, you as a mod user don't generally need to update it unless you are installing a new mod that depends on a feature only implemented in newer version of MMAP. Bugs do occur as I develop features, and generally it is not end of the world. Please [url=https://smapi.io/log]report your problem with a log[/url], then roll back to a previous version of mod while I fix things.
